name: GET /oauth calls Box GET /api/oauth2/authorize/ with the startup client-credentials token and returns its body

source.reference: oauth2-client-credentials-using-the-HTTP-connector/src/main/app/http-client-credentials.xml (listener path=oauth, http:request config-ref=HTTP_Request_Configuration path=/ method=GET, basePath=/api/oauth2/authorize, oauth2:client-credentials-grant-type); Mule 3.8 ClientCredentialsGrantType#authenticate adds 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'; the listener returns the requester payload and its mime type with status 200
